options.text: Have you got any quests for me?

steps.player: Do you have any quests for me? I really want one. I really want to help out!

steps.text: You murmur under your breath something about how great the rewards were last time you did a quest for Dimintheis.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: My family consider what you did for us a great service. We couldn't possibly trouble you further.

steps.player: There must be SOMETHING you need help with. I am a great adventurer after all.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: There really isn't anything, I am very content with life right now.

options.text: I guess money does buy happiness.

steps.player: I guess money really does buy happiness.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: What was that? I didn't quite catch that.

steps.player: Nothing...

options.text: Oh come on, however menial, I want to help!

steps.player: Oh come on, surely there's something I can help out with! I want to help, however menial it is.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: Okay okay. Fine then. Whilst I don't have anything for you, how about you try my sons, they are always wanting something done.

steps.player: Fantastic! I'll get straight to it!

steps.text: You smell the sweet smell of the great rewards that may soon come.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: Have you spoke to Avan, Caleb and Johnathon yet?

steps.player: Nope, not yet!
Hello there Avan, I've had a bit of spare time lately, and I was wondering whether you had anything I could help you out with, like a quest or something?

steps.speaker: Avan
steps.text: Honestly [player name], everything is fantastic! What you did for me and my family is amazing. My lady was very impressed with the perfect jewellery you obtained for me!

steps.player: You know, I really have a LOT of spare time right now. Anything, I will help out with anything.

steps.speaker: Avan
steps.text: I couldn't bring myself to trouble you any further [player name]. Thank you for everything, but I am content.
If Avan is the first brother the player talks to:

steps.player: Very well, I'll go and see if your other brothers need anything...

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come fades slightly.
If Avan is the second brother the player talks to:

steps.player: Very well, I'll go and see if your other brothers need anything...

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come fades even more.
If Avan is the last brother the player talks to:

steps.player: I do one quest for you all and it solves all of your problems? Amazing... I'll go and tell your father how happy you all are!

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come has almost faded completely.

steps.player: Are you absolutely sure there is nothing I can help you out with?

steps.speaker: Avan
steps.text: Look, I really just want to get on with my life, your insistence on wanting another quest is getting annoying!

steps.player: Caleb! As an adventurer, I am ready to help you with whatever you need... again! What can I help you with?

steps.text: You daydream briefly of what the rich family could offer you this time as a reward.

steps.speaker: Caleb
steps.text: ... and that's when I found the broken lamping stick. Maybe you could help me investigate?

steps.player: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that, my mind was erm... elsewhere.

steps.speaker: Caleb
steps.text: Well if you aren't going to listen to the problem, it's fine, don't worry about it. Nothing an experienced chef can't solve himself!

steps.player: I'm sorry! Please let me help.

steps.speaker: Caleb
steps.text: No! Not every problem in my life needs an adventurer to come solve it for me anyway. I'm happy and there's nothing else either!
If Caleb is the first brother the player talks to:

steps.player: Very well, I'll go and see if your other brothers need anything...

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come fades slightly.
If Caleb is the second brother the player talks to:

steps.player: Very well, I'll go and see if your other brothers need anything...

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come fades even more.
If Caleb is the last brother the player talks to:

steps.player: I do one quest for you all and it solves all of your problems? Amazing... I'll go and tell your father how happy you all are!

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come has almost faded completely.

steps.player: Are you sure there's nothing I can do, a chef can always do with help in their kitchen right?

steps.speaker: Caleb
steps.text: I'm a very competent cook! I do not need your assistance [player name]. Please leave me be.

steps.player: I killed demons, I cured your poison and restored your family's honour! What can I help you with next Johnathon?

steps.speaker: Johnathon
steps.text: Actually, come to think of it...
Your eyes light up.

steps.player: Yes...

steps.speaker: Johnathon
steps.text: I've been having this issue. You see the lady I seek is trapped up the top of a very large tower of a very large castle, and has been for all of her life so far.

steps.speaker: Johnathon
steps.text: There is but one problem, a fierce dragon circles the castle, breathing fire at anyone who dares go near.
The sweet smell of the great rewards sweeps over you with incredible speed.

steps.player: This is sounding like a great opportunity to be heroic, shall I go get her for you?

steps.speaker: Johnathon
steps.text: Ha ha! You would believe anything. That was just a children's story!

steps.player: Very funny Johnathon, I can't help but laugh...
So do you actually have any problems I can help you with?

steps.speaker: Johnathon
steps.text: Everything is fantastic [player name]! You adventurers really do seem to love quests, but I do not have one for you today.
If Johnathon is the first brother the player talks to:

steps.player: Very well, I'll go and see if your other brothers need anything...

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come fades slightly.
If Johnathon is the second brother the player talks to:

steps.player: Very well, I'll go and see if your other brothers need anything...

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come fades even more.
If Johnathon is the last brother the player talks to:

steps.player: I do one quest for you all and it solves all of your problems? Amazing... I'll go and tell your father how happy you all are!

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come has almost faded completely.

steps.player: Are you sure there's nothing I can do, perhaps even teach you about Death Rune magicks, where your skills do not live up to mine.

steps.speaker: Johnathon
steps.text: I find that very insulting [player name]. You do not need to remind me of your superior skills. Leave me be.

steps.player: I have been and spoken to Avan, Caleb and Johnathon and none of them need anything from me!

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: That is excellent news [player name]. It's good to hear they are doing well.
The sweet smell of great rewards is a distant memory.

steps.player: Yeah... you're welcome.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: Come to think of it, there is something you can help me out with!

steps.player: Yes! I accept your quest!

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: Slow down. I haven't told you what it is yet!

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: I need 500,000 coins. Can you help me out with that?

steps.player: You just want coins?! Aren't you wealthy! Why do you need coins from me?

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: Okay, I suppose there will be no time better than this to tell you the truth.

steps.player: Go on...

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: Our family just pretends to be rich [player name]. We gave ourselves a fancy surname, pretended the gauntlets are a family heirloom and asked adventurers to solve our family issues.

steps.player: Wait, so all of this was for nothing? You just lied to me!

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: No no, your work was indeed very helpful, the crest is important to us, it helps to portray that we are indeed wealthy, despite the fact we are not.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: I mean, if you were wealthy, would you live in a tiny house in the darkest corner of Varrock? Not a chance. This is your chance to do us a final favour, may I have 500,000 coins from you?
If the player does not have enough coins:

steps.player: I don't have enough coins on me.

steps.text: You hand over 500,000 coins to Dimintheis.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: Thank you very much. In appreciation, I will inform Avan, Caleb and Johnathon that you did yet another great deed for the family, and that you would find more pairs of those gauntlets useful.

steps.player: Well this didn't feel very heroic...
You don't need 500,000 coins from me! I don't believe you! You can keep your rewards.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: I will be here if you change your mind.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: I need 500,000 coins. Can you help me out with that?

steps.player: You just want coins?! Aren't you wealthy! Why do you need coins from me?

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: Okay, I suppose there will be no time better than this to tell you the truth.

steps.player: Go on...

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: Our family just pretends to be rich [player name]. We gave ourselves a fancy surname, pretended the gauntlets are a family heirloom and asked adventurers to solve our family issues.

steps.player: Wait, so all of this was for nothing? You just lied to me!

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: No no, your work was indeed very helpful, the crest is important to us, it helps to portray that we are indeed wealthy, despite the fact we are not.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: I mean, if you were wealthy, would you live in a tiny house in the darkest corner of Varrock? Not a chance. This is your chance to do us a final favour, may I have 500,000 coins from you?

post-miniquest-dialogue-dimintheis.speaker: Dimintheis
post-miniquest-dialogue-dimintheis.text: I will not forget what you did for my family [player name]. Those 500,000 coins have allowed us to put food on the table.

options.text: Could I get another pair of gauntlets?

steps.player: Anyway, I was wondering if I could get more of those gauntlets?

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: You may, but you'll have to ask my sons for them, unless you just want a pair of the Steel gauntlets.

steps.player: Yes, I do want a pair of steel gauntlets please.

steps.text: Dimintheis hands you a pair of Steel gauntlets.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: Here you go.

steps.player: No thanks Dimintheis.

options.text: The gauntlets are a family heirloom?

steps.player: I thought these gauntlets were a family heirloom, how come you have several of them?

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: I'm sorry for lying to you [player name], it was just all part of the ploy to make our family seem wealthy.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: They're not heirlooms at all, we have crates full of the things hidden away in the basement.

steps.player: And you still think that these are an acceptable reward for what I have done for your family?

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: It's all I have to give...

steps.player: Very well, I do admit, they are useful.

post-miniquest-dialogue-avan.speaker: Avan
post-miniquest-dialogue-avan.text: I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.

post-miniquest-dialogue-avan.speaker: Avan
post-miniquest-dialogue-avan.text: As a token of my appreciation, I will happily forge you as many pairs of Goldsmith gauntlets as you desire.
Avan hands you a pair of Goldsmith gauntlets.

post-miniquest-dialogue-avan.speaker: Avan
post-miniquest-dialogue-avan.text: You will find the rate you gain experience when smelting gold much improved whilst wearing these gauntlets.

post-miniquest-dialogue-caleb.speaker: Caleb
post-miniquest-dialogue-caleb.text: I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.

post-miniquest-dialogue-caleb.speaker: Caleb
post-miniquest-dialogue-caleb.text: As thanks, I'll provide you with as many pairs of Cooking gauntlets as you wish.
Caleb hands you a pair of Cooking gauntlets.

post-miniquest-dialogue-caleb.speaker: Caleb
post-miniquest-dialogue-caleb.text: You will find the rate you burn certain foods is much reduced whilst wearing these gauntlets.

post-miniquest-dialogue-johnathon.speaker: Johnathon
post-miniquest-dialogue-johnathon.text: I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.

post-miniquest-dialogue-johnathon.speaker: Johnathon
post-miniquest-dialogue-johnathon.text: If you want, I'll provide you with as many pairs of Chaos gauntlets as you wish to say thanks!
Johnathon hands you a pair of Chaos gauntlets.

post-miniquest-dialogue-johnathon.speaker: Johnathon
post-miniquest-dialogue-johnathon.text: You will find the power of bolt spells increases substantially whilst wearing these gauntlets.
